spongebob.name: SpongeBob
spongebob.bio: An endlessly cheerful fry cook who lives in a pineapple and loves his job more than anything in the ocean.
spongebob.catchphrase: I'm ready! I'm ready! I'm ready!

patrick.name: Patrick Star
patrick.bio: SpongeBob's best friend. Lives under a rock. Thinks very hard about things, occasionally.

squidward.name: Squidward
squidward.bio: A grumpy cashier and self-declared artistic genius who just wants some peace and quiet for his clarinet.

mr_krabs.name: Mr. Krabs
mr_krabs.bio: Owner of the Krusty Krab. A retired sea captain whose one true love is money. Argh!

sandy.name: Sandy Cheeks
sandy.bio: A karate-chopping scientist squirrel from Texas who lives under the sea in an air-filled dome.

arnold.name: Arnold
arnold.bio: A kind, optimistic fourth-grader with a football-shaped head who lives with his grandparents at a boarding house. Always tries to help.

helga.name: Helga Pataki
helga.bio: The toughest kid in the fourth grade, with one eyebrow and a big pink bow. Secretly writes love poems about Arnold.

gerald.name: Gerald
gerald.bio: Arnold's cool, level-headed best friend. Keeper of the neighborhood's urban legends. Tall hair, taller confidence.

grandpa.name: Grandpa Phil
grandpa.bio: Arnold's grandpa. Runs the Sunset Arms boarding house, tells tall tales from the old days, and calls Arnold "Shortman".

phoebe.name: Phoebe
phoebe.bio: Helga's brilliant, loyal best friend. Top of the class, fluent in facts, and always ready with a plan.

plankton.name: Plankton
plankton.bio: A tiny evil genius who owns the Chum Bucket and wants the secret patty formula more than anything.
plankton.catchphrase: I'll get that formula if it's the last thing I do!

karen.name: Karen
karen.bio: Plankton's computer wife. Smarter than him, and she knows it.
karen.catchphrase: Plankton, that plan has a ninety-nine percent chance of failure.

mrs_puff.name: Mrs. Puff
mrs_puff.bio: The very patient boating teacher. Puffs up when she's frightened, which is often.

pearl.name: Pearl
pearl.bio: Mr. Krabs' teenage whale daughter. Loves the mall, hates being embarrassed.

gary.name: Gary
gary.bio: SpongeBob's pet snail. Says only 'meow' but understands everything.

larry.name: Larry the Lobster
larry.bio: Bikini Bottom's lifeguard and gym enthusiast. Never skips claw day.

mermaid_man.name: Mermaid Man
mermaid_man.bio: A retired superhero who still answers the call of duty, as long as it's before his nap.

barnacle_boy.name: Barnacle Boy
barnacle_boy.bio: Mermaid Man's sidekick for sixty years. Still called a boy. Still not happy about it.
barnacle_boy.catchphrase: I'm not a boy! I'm a man!

squilliam.name: Squilliam Fancyson
squilliam.bio: Squidward's rich, smug rival from band camp. Has a yacht, a mansion and a unibrow.
squilliam.catchphrase: Well, well, well. If it isn't Squidward.

bubble_bass.name: Bubble Bass
bubble_bass.bio: The pickiest customer in Bikini Bottom. Has opinions about every pickle.

king_neptune.name: King Neptune
king_neptune.bio: Ruler of the seven seas. Very proud of his crown, his trident and his hair.

grandma.name: Grandma Pookie
grandma.bio: Arnold's wildly adventurous grandma. Karate expert, explorer, and occasional pirate.

harold.name: Harold
harold.bio: The biggest kid in the fourth grade. Loves food, hates being teased.

stinky.name: Stinky
stinky.bio: Tall, slow-talking and kind. Lemon pudding is his favorite thing in the world.
stinky.catchphrase: Well, I reckon that's mighty fine.

sid.name: Sid
sid.bio: Arnold's jumpy friend who believes every scary story he hears.
sid.catchphrase: Oh man, this is bad! This is really bad!

rhonda.name: Rhonda
rhonda.bio: The most fashionable girl at P.S. 118. Has opinions about everyone's outfits.

big_bob.name: Big Bob
big_bob.bio: Helga's loud dad and the Beeper King of Hillwood.

eugene.name: Eugene Horowitz
eugene.bio: The unluckiest kid in Hillwood. Trips, falls and gets stuck in things daily, and stays cheerful anyway.

lila.name: Lila Sawyer
lila.bio: The sweetest, politest girl in the fourth grade. Everything is ever so nice to her.

olga.name: Olga Pataki
olga.bio: Helga's perfect older sister. Straight A's, piano prodigy, and very, very dramatic.

mr_simmons.name: Mr. Simmons
mr_simmons.bio: The fourth grade teacher. Believes every student is special, and says so often.

curly.name: Curly
curly.bio: Thaddeus Gammelthorpe, known as Curly. Wild, unpredictable and secretly in love with Rhonda.

doug.name: Doug Funnie
doug.bio: A thoughtful kid who writes everything in his journal and imagines himself as a superhero.

skeeter.name: Skeeter
skeeter.bio: Doug's best friend. Blue, goofy and the world's best honker.

patti.name: Patti Mayonnaise
patti.bio: Sporty, smart and kind. Doug has had a crush on her since forever.

roger.name: Roger Klotz
roger.bio: The local bully with a leather jacket and a green complexion.

porkchop.name: Porkchop
porkchop.bio: Doug's very smart dog. Walks on two legs when nobody's looking.

judy.name: Judy Funnie
judy.bio: Doug's older sister. A dramatic artist who quotes Shakespeare at breakfast.
judy.catchphrase: Doug, you are SUCH a philistine.

beebe.name: Beebe Bluff
beebe.bio: Patti's best friend. Her family owns most of Bluffington.
beebe.catchphrase: Daddy will just buy another one.

mr_dink.name: Mr. Dink
mr_dink.bio: The Funnies' neighbor. Buys every gadget ever made.

connie.name: Connie Benge
connie.bio: A kind, quiet classmate who'd like to be noticed more.

chalky.name: Chalky Studebaker
chalky.bio: Straight-A student, star athlete, and annoyingly nice about it.

mr_bone.name: Mr. Bone
mr_bone.bio: The vice principal. Runs a very, very tight ship.

theda_funnie.name: Theda Funnie
theda_funnie.bio: Doug's mom. Calm, kind and always ready with a snack and some good advice.

phil_funnie.name: Phil Funnie
phil_funnie.bio: Doug's dad. Loves dad jokes, his garage and a good old-fashioned project.

al_sleech.name: Al Sleech
al_sleech.bio: One half of the Sleech twins, Bluffington's youngest geniuses. Finishes his brother's sentences.

moo_sleech.name: Moo Sleech
moo_sleech.bio: The other half of the Sleech twins. Starts his brother's sentences.

ned_cauphee.name: Ned Cauphee
ned_cauphee.bio: One of Roger's pals. Tall, slow and not quite as mean as he pretends to be.

tommy.name: Tommy Pickles
tommy.bio: A brave one-year-old with a toy screwdriver who can open any playpen.
tommy.catchphrase: A baby's gotta do what a baby's gotta do!

chuckie.name: Chuckie Finster
chuckie.bio: Tommy's best friend. Scared of almost everything, brave when it counts.
chuckie.catchphrase: I don't think this is such a good idea!

angelica.name: Angelica Pickles
angelica.bio: Tommy's bossy three-year-old cousin. Rules the playpen with an iron fist.

phil.name: Phil DeVille
phil.bio: One of the twins. Loves worms, mud and arguing with his sister.

lil.name: Lil DeVille
lil.bio: The other twin. Loves worms just as much, thank you very much.

stu.name: Stu Pickles
stu.bio: Tommy's dad. Toy inventor. Most of his toys explode.
stu.catchphrase: This one's gonna be a winner!

didi.name: Didi Pickles
didi.bio: Tommy's mom. Has read every baby book ever written.

grandpa_lou.name: Grandpa Lou
grandpa_lou.bio: Tommy's grandpa. Supposed to be babysitting. Usually napping.

spike.name: Spike
spike.bio: The Pickles' big scruffy dog. The babies' noble steed.

susie.name: Susie Carmichael
susie.bio: The kid across the street. Smart, brave, and Angelica's rival.

betty.name: Betty DeVille
betty.bio: Phil and Lil's mom. Loud, sporty and never without a whistle.

howard.name: Howard DeVille
howard.bio: Phil and Lil's dad. Gentle, nervous and a very careful cook.

chas.name: Chas Finster
chas.bio: Chuckie's dad. Tall, thin and worried about everything, just like his son.

drew.name: Drew Pickles
drew.bio: Angelica's dad and Stu's big brother. A busy businessman who can't say no to his princess.

charlotte.name: Charlotte Pickles
charlotte.bio: Angelica's mom. Runs a big company from her cell phone.

kira.name: Kira Finster
kira.bio: Chuckie's new stepmom. Kind, calm and great at calming down Chuckie.

kimi.name: Kimi Finster
kimi.bio: Chuckie's new little sister. Brave, bouncy and ready for any adventure.

jessie.name: Jessie
jessie.bio: Team Rocket's dramatic, short-tempered leader of schemes.

james.name: James
james.bio: Team Rocket's softhearted schemer. Loves bottle caps and dramatic poses.

meowth.name: Meowth
meowth.bio: A cat who taught himself to talk and walk. The brains (and the mouth) of the team.

wobbuffet.name: Wobbuffet
wobbuffet.bio: A big blue blob who only ever says its own name, very enthusiastically.

giovanni.name: Giovanni
giovanni.bio: Team Rocket's stern boss. Disappointed. Always disappointed.

ash.name: Ash Ketchum
ash.bio: A ten-year-old trainer who wants to be the very best. Like no one ever was.

pikachu.name: Pikachu
pikachu.bio: Ash's electric mouse. Refuses to ride in a ball.

misty.name: Misty
misty.bio: A Water-type Pokémon trainer with a short temper and a big mallet.

brock.name: Brock
brock.bio: A rock-type trainer and great cook. Falls in love in every town.

nurse_joy.name: Nurse Joy
nurse_joy.bio: Runs the Pokémon Center. Has a dozen cousins who look exactly like her.
nurse_joy.catchphrase: We hope to see you again!

officer_jenny.name: Officer Jenny
officer_jenny.bio: Town police. Has a dozen cousins who look exactly like her too.

goku.name: Goku
goku.bio: A cheerful Saiyan martial artist who's always hungry and always training.

vegeta.name: Vegeta
vegeta.bio: The proud prince of all Saiyans. Goku's rival, whether Goku likes it or not.
vegeta.catchphrase: I am the prince of all Saiyans!

gohan.name: Gohan
gohan.bio: Goku's son. Would rather be studying, but secretly the strongest of them all.

piccolo.name: Piccolo
piccolo.bio: A grumpy green warrior from Planet Namek. Gohan's mentor and secret softie.

krillin.name: Krillin
krillin.bio: Goku's best friend. Bald, brave and usually the first to get flattened.

bulma.name: Bulma
bulma.bio: A genius inventor from Capsule Corp. Builds everything the heroes need.
bulma.catchphrase: Do I have to do everything myself?

master_roshi.name: Master Roshi
master_roshi.bio: The old Turtle Hermit who trained Goku. Mostly naps and reads magazines now.

frieza.name: Frieza
frieza.bio: A tiny, terribly polite tyrant who wants to rule the universe.

cell.name: Cell
cell.bio: A perfect bio-android who loves holding tournaments about himself.

trunks.name: Trunks
trunks.bio: Vegeta and Bulma's son from a gloomy future. Carries a very cool sword.

chi_chi.name: Chi-Chi
chi_chi.bio: Goku's wife. Wants Gohan to study and Goku to get a job. Has a frying pan.

eren.name: Eren Jaeger
eren.bio: A hot-headed Scout who swore to wipe out every last Titan.

mikasa.name: Mikasa Ackerman
mikasa.bio: Eren's quiet, unstoppable friend. Never takes off her red scarf.

armin.name: Armin Arlert
armin.bio: The team's brilliant planner. Dreams of seeing the ocean.

levi.name: Captain Levi
levi.bio: Humanity's strongest soldier. Also humanity's fussiest cleaner.

hange.name: Hange Zoë
hange.bio: A scientist who thinks Titans are the most fascinating things ever.

jean.name: Jean Kirstein
jean.bio: A cocky Scout who'd much rather have a nice safe job.

sasha.name: Sasha Braus
sasha.bio: A sharpshooter with a bottomless appetite. Will steal your potato.

connie_springer.name: Connie Springer
connie_springer.bio: A loud, cheerful Scout who isn't always sure what's going on.

reiner.name: Reiner
reiner.bio: A big, dependable Scout everybody trusts. Has a lot on his mind.

erwin.name: Commander Erwin
erwin.bio: The Scouts' fearless commander. Gives very rousing speeches.

smiling_titan.name: Smiling Titan
smiling_titan.bio: A huge, smiling Titan. Nobody knows what it's thinking. Probably lunch.

walt.name: Walter White
walt.bio: A mild-mannered chemistry teacher who makes the purest blue rock candy in the whole Southwest.

jesse.name: Jesse Pinkman
jesse.bio: Walt's former student and candy-making partner. Says 'yo' a lot.

skyler.name: Skyler White
skyler.bio: Walt's wife. Suspects something. Keeps the family's books.

hank.name: Hank Schrader
hank.bio: Walt's brother-in-law. A loud, lovable agent who collects minerals.

marie.name: Marie Schrader
marie.bio: Hank's wife. Everything she owns is purple.

flynn.name: Flynn
flynn.bio: Walt's son. Loves breakfast more than anything in the world.

saul.name: Saul Goodman
saul.bio: A fast-talking lawyer with loud suits and louder TV ads.

gus.name: Gus Fring
gus.bio: The calm, extremely polite owner of Los Pollos Hermanos chicken.

mike.name: Mike Ehrmantraut
mike.bio: A tired fixer who's seen it all. Fond of half measures. Not fond of Jesse.

badger.name: Badger
badger.bio: Jesse's friend. Has big ideas for a space movie.

skinny_pete.name: Skinny Pete
skinny_pete.bio: Jesse's other friend. Secretly a great piano player.

mario.name: Mario
mario.bio: A plumber who jumps on things. Saves the princess most weekends.

luigi.name: Luigi
luigi.bio: Mario's taller brother. Brave, mostly. Scared of ghosts, definitely.

peach.name: Princess Peach
peach.bio: Ruler of the Mushroom Kingdom. Gets kidnapped a lot. Bakes a great cake.

daisy.name: Princess Daisy
daisy.bio: A sporty princess from a neighboring kingdom. Very loud. Very fun.

wario.name: Wario
wario.bio: Mario's greedy rival. Loves gold and garlic.

toad.name: Toad
toad.bio: A loyal mushroom retainer who tells everyone the princess is in another castle.
toad.catchphrase: The princess is in another castle!

bowser.name: Bowser
bowser.bio: King of the Koopas. Wants the princess and the kingdom. Gets neither.

yoshi.name: Yoshi
yoshi.bio: A friendly green dinosaur who'll eat anything with his long tongue.

donkey_kong.name: Donkey Kong
donkey_kong.bio: A big banana-loving ape in a red tie.

goomba.name: Goomba
goomba.bio: A grumpy walking mushroom. Gets stepped on for a living.

koopa_troopa.name: Koopa Troopa
koopa_troopa.bio: A turtle soldier in Bowser's army. Secretly just wants a vacation.

samus.name: Samus Aran
samus.bio: A legendary bounty hunter in a power suit. A woman of very few words.

dark_samus.name: Dark Samus
dark_samus.bio: A shadowy copy of Samus made of strange blue energy.

ridley.name: Ridley
ridley.bio: A space-pirate dragon who never, ever stays defeated.

kraid.name: Kraid
kraid.bio: An enormous reptile who fires the spikes off his own belly.

mother_brain.name: Mother Brain
mother_brain.bio: The giant brain in a jar who runs the space pirates.

baby_metroid.name: Baby Metroid
baby_metroid.bio: A floating jellyfish creature that thinks Samus is its mom.

adam.name: Adam Malkovich
adam.bio: Samus's old commanding officer. Very good at saying 'any objections?'

chozo_elder.name: Chozo Elder
chozo_elder.bio: A wise, ancient bird-person who raised Samus.

space_pirate.name: Space Pirate
space_pirate.bio: A clawed space pirate grunt. Mostly guards doors.

etecoon.name: Etecoon
etecoon.bio: A tiny green wall-jumping critter. Very good at showing you the way.

dachora.name: Dachora
dachora.bio: A fast ostrich-like bird. Can run faster than the speed of plot.

kirby.name: Kirby
kirby.bio: A round pink hero from Dream Land. Inhales anything. Only ever says 'Poyo!'

dedede.name: King Dedede
dedede.bio: The greedy, self-proclaimed king of Dream Land. Loves food almost as much as Kirby does.

meta_knight.name: Meta Knight
meta_knight.bio: A masked swordsman of honor. Always appears dramatically.

waddle_dee.name: Waddle Dee
waddle_dee.bio: One of the king's many round helpers. Friendly and easily flattened.

bandana_dee.name: Bandana Dee
bandana_dee.bio: The bravest Waddle Dee, with a blue bandana and a spear.

waddle_doo.name: Waddle Doo
waddle_doo.bio: A one-eyed helper who zaps things with his eye beam.

magolor.name: Magolor
magolor.bio: A hooded traveler from another dimension. Very charming. Possibly up to something.

marx.name: Marx
marx.bio: A giggling jester who wants to rule Pop Star. Never trust that grin.

adeleine.name: Adeleine
adeleine.bio: A traveling painter whose drawings come to life.

ribbon.name: Ribbon
ribbon.bio: A tiny fairy from Ripple Star with a big red bow.

whispy_woods.name: Whispy Woods
whispy_woods.bio: A grumpy old tree who drops apples on people he doesn't like.

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.bio: A fancy voice from somewhere above the waves.
